verdict.rationale: Make ships a built-in 'AI Agents' app/feature (agentic automation) with API endpoints to create, update, run and delete agents, indicating users can delegate tasks to an in-product AI assistant, but this is still in open beta and documentation is very thin with no detail on assistant capabilities, UI, or independent hands-on validation. missing for 10: detailed feature documentation, evidence of general availability (not just open beta), concrete examples of task delegation, independent/hands-on corroboration.
